'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tom Hollingworth LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingworth]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
